text: 2026年9月2日—4日，应墨西哥科学、人文、技术和创新部部长鲁伊斯邀请，科技部部长阴和俊率团访问墨西哥，并在墨西哥城共同主持召开中墨政府间常设委员会科技分委会第九次会议。会上，双方回顾了科技分委会第八次会议以来取得的成效，交流了两国科技发展战略和政策，探讨了下一步中墨科技创新合作的优先领域方向并达成共识。会后，双方签署《中华人民共和国科学技术部与墨西哥合众国科学、人文、技术和创新部关于科技创新合作的谅解备忘录》及科技分委会会议纪要。（科技部）
text_en: From September 2-4, 2026, at the invitation of Mexican Secretary of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation Ruiz, Minister of Science and Technology Yin Hejun led a delegation to visit Mexico and co-chaired the 9th meeting of the Science and Technology Sub-commission of the China-Mexico Permanent Intergovernmental Commission in Mexico City. During the meeting, both sides reviewed the achievements since the 8th meeting, exchanged views on their national science and technology development strategies and policies, and discussed and reached consensus on priority areas for future China-Mexico sci-tech innovation cooperation. After the meeting, both sides signed the Memorandum of Understanding on Sci-tech Innovation Cooperation between the Ministry of Science and Technology of the People's Republic of China and the Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation of the United Mexican States, along with the minutes of the sub-commission meeting. (Ministry of Science and Technology)
